title: Coral Casino UK Login: How to Register and Claim Your First Bonus

content.text: Coral Casino offers UK players an amazing gaming experience. The service offers a huge range of casino games and sports betting. This is a great opportunity to fully enjoy a full variety of entertainment with one account.
Coral is a bookmaker that has been operating in the UK in the format of land-based stores since 1926. Stores are represented in almost all major cities in the UK.

Already in 2011, the company launched its own website with a casino and a bookmaker. Here you can place bets, spin slot machines, play poker, bingo and much more. To register, new customers can use the standard online form or use their Coral Rewards card.

sections.heading: Coral Casino Account via Registration Form

content.text: Registration on the site or app of Coral Casino UK can happen the easiest by filling out a special registration form. In order to do this, follow through the step by step instructions.

items: Go to the main page of the site or install the mobile application
Click on the 'Join' button on the home page of the gambling platform
In the form that appears, select your country of residence, as well as the game currency
Next, enter a valid email address that belongs to you
Come up with a username. If it matches with already registered clients, the site will offer options
Create the most reliable and secure password to protect your account
Click the Continue button to proceed to the next stage of registration
On the second page, indicate your gender, first name, last name and date of birth
Click the Continue button again to go to page 3 of the registration form
Here you will need a postal code, country code, phone number
Complete the registration process by clicking the Create My Account button

content.text: It is worth noting that all information that you filled will be verified. Thus, make sure that you use only real information, including contact information that is your own (email, phone number, etc.).
You can set up deposit limits immediately after completing the registration, or do it later.

Additionally, you will be asked to subscribe to the newsletter and bonuses in a way convenient for you. For example, by phone number, email address or SMS. But you have the right to unsubscribe from the newsletter.

sections.heading: Registration with the Coral Rewards Card

content.text: In the UK, many players place bets in land-based Coral bookmaker stores. In this case, each of them has a special rewards card. It can be used for quick registration on the casino and bookmaker websites.

To do this, click on the Log In button and at the bottom of the authorization form, follow the Log In with Coral Rewards link. Then you will only need to enter your unique card number and PIN code, which consists of 4 digits.
Here you will automatically be connected with your new account and you will not be obliged to pass through the entire registration process.

sections.heading: How to Login to Coral Casino UK Account

content.text: Logging into an account on the website and in the Coral Casino application is identical. You need to open the main page and click on the Log In button. Here you will be presented with two authorization methods at once.
The first is via email or username. Simply enter your account details, password and click the button to confirm your login.
The second option is to quickly log in via the Coral Rewards card. In this case, you will only need the card number and 4-digit PIN code.
Coral Casino and the bookmaker operate in strict accordance with the current UK legislation. Therefore, all users must pass verification.

To do this, you must provide genuine and accurate information at the registration stage. After logging into your personal account, fill out the Profile page and also upload some documents. Please note that you can only deposit funds to your balance after confirming your account.

If the address on the license does not match, then send a bank statement or a copy of the utility bill for the last 3 months. Specialists will check and confirm your account within 24 hours.
